name: edgar_amendments
description:
Amended filings (forms ending in /A, such as 10-K/A, 10-Q/A, 8-K/A, SC 13G/A) for one company, from SEC EDGAR, to spot corrections and restatements.
Returns {cik, company_name, amendments_count, amendments: [{accessionNumber, filingDate, form, reportDate, document_url}]}, newest first.
Inputs (* required): cik* (string, SEC Central Index Key, up to 10 digits; from edgar_company_search), limit (integer 1-100, default 20).
Only the recent-filings block of the EDGAR submissions file is searched. For the original filings use edgar_filings_by_form.
Example: {"cik": "0000320193", "limit": 10}
No API key needed (SEC data.sec.gov; 110 ms between requests).

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Amendments (forms ending with /A) indicate corrections to previously filed reports. May signal accounting issues or errors.
warnings: Multiple amendments may indicate accounting issues
Material amendments can impact financial analysis
Compare amended vs original filings for changes
